periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree inward-tilting oblique axis relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with primary vertical elongation.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering of the patch towards the muzzle, creating a teardrop-like inferior profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped posterior boundary at the interface of the black shoulder band and white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial lateral thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between the ears, which are positioned on the upper-outer quadrants of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, regular convex curvature with rounded tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant chromic variation on the ventral pelage, showing a brownish-tan discoloration compared to the white cranial and neck fur.
